title: The Godfather Part II
synopsis: A young Vito in New York, a cold Michael in Nevada, and a family that does not survive its own success.

nodes.text: A senator in your study with a hand on his price.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Stern.
“Buy him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Calm.

nodes.text: You own everything you can see from the lake. There is no one left to share it with. You sit anyway, like a king.
You go to Sicily under the orange trees and you read the same psalm every morning. You are still cold. The trees do not mind.
Kay's eyes through the closing door for forty years. You will see them when you die. You already see them now.
